sections.content: Report from dashboard: 1. Data Discovery & Classification. Generated automatically by DBDOME.

sections.query:
select at.server , at.query , last_request_end_time, c.column_name , c.table_name from monitoring.v_combined_transactions at
join(
select TABLE_NAME ,  column_name from monitoring.v_sensitive_columns 
) c on at.query like '%'||c.column_name ||'%'
and last_request_end_time > Now() - interval '15 minutes'
